findings.message: The 'other' text input shows `value.trim()` but stores the raw value. React redraws the input with the trimmed value, so a space typed at the end of the value is deleted before the next key arrives. As a result, a client name with more than one word can't be typed. Fix: show the stored value as it is, and trim only in `edited()`. Mark the 'other' choice with separate state instead of the `" "` sentinel value.
findings.scenario: Pick '+ new…' and type 'Acme Corp'. After 'Acme ' the box shows 'Acme' and the space is gone. The next key gives 'AcmeC', and the project is created with client 'AcmeCorp'.

findings.message: The link card's branch field is built from `repoFields(a.defaultBranch ? [a.defaultBranch] : [])` and always preselects 'main'. `edited()` always sends `defaultBranch`. The tool's documented rule, 'kept on a relink unless given', is therefore broken on the chat path: a relink always overwrites the stored branch with main. Fix: read the project's stored `repo_default_ref` in `linkCard`, offer it, and preselect it (main only when the project has no link yet). Alternatively, leave the branch out when it hasn't been touched.
findings.scenario: CON is linked to github.com/example/portal on 'develop'. The user picks 'Link a repo to CON' and confirms the same URL. `repo_default_ref` becomes 'main', so pushes from develop no longer count as default-branch pushes.

findings.message: A retry outcome that names no field ('That didn't work: … Try again or cancel.') goes into `check` as a general message. Then `blocked = … || Boolean(check?.message)` disables the confirm button, and it stays disabled until the person edits a field. The card offers a retry it won't let the person do. Fix: block only on field-check refusals, not on a server retry note that names no field. Alternatively, clear that note on the next confirm attempt.
findings.scenario: A transient error after the service is reached returns `{state:'open', note:'That didn't work: …'}`. The card shows the note, and 'Create NWP' stays disabled until a field is changed.

findings.message: `rewordCard` swallows a failed `t.card()` call (only logged) and then keeps the old `look`, `lines` and `form` from the action as the model proposed it. Only the title is recomputed. The receipt (`look.done`) then names the input as it was before the edits, not what ran. `setUpProjectCard` runs a DB query (`clientsOf`) each time, so this failure can really happen. Fix: when the reword fails, drop the stale `look.done`/`lines` and fall back to `doneNote` built from the input that ran.
findings.scenario: The model proposed key NWP and the user edits it to NWX. During confirm, `clientsOf` throws (a pool timeout). NWX is created, but the card says 'Created NWP · Northwind Portal'.

findings.message: `KEY = /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$/` copies the key rule in `projectInput.key` (project-create.ts:20), with a different message. `checkInput` already parses the draft schema (which contains `projectInput.key`) before `proposeSetUp` runs, so this branch is a second copy that can drift from the first. Fix: delete the `KEY` check from `proposeSetUp` and rely on the schema.
findings.scenario: If projectInput's key rule is widened to 12 characters, proposeSetUp still refuses an 11-character key on the card with a different message, while MCP accepts it.

findings.message: The default branch 'main' is written three times: the service (`defaultBranch ?? "main"`), the receipt (`repoDone`, `branch ?? "main"`) and the card field (`repoFields` value 'main'). Use one exported constant.
The link permission check is skipped when the context has no viewer (`v && …`), so a call without a viewer links a repo without `delivery:project:link`. Refuse a `repoUrl` when there is no viewer.

A refusal is drawn only next to a form field with that name, or as a general message when it has no field. A refusal whose `field` isn't on the form (e.g. a schema issue on `projectKey` for link_project_repo) shows nowhere, yet it still disables the button. Show refusals for unknown fields as general messages.

The key hint '✓ free · …' is drawn whenever the last check passed, including while a new value is still being checked. A taken key reads as free for up to 350 ms plus the server round trip. Hide the hint while a check is in flight.

`checkCardField` catches every error and returns the same "Couldn't check that just now." That includes a card already decided in another tab (`NotPendingError`), an expired card and a viewer mismatch. The button stays disabled with a message that suggests trying again, when the card can't be confirmed at all. Map `NotPendingError` and expiry to a note that says so.
findings.scenario: Tab A confirms the card. In tab B, editing a field shows "Couldn't check that just now" forever instead of "already handled".
